title: Yeti Summit Series Honeydew Blackcurrant Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Yeti Summit Series Honeydew Blackcurrant Ice combines the smooth, sweet taste of Honeydew Melon with the bold, tangy flavour of ripe Blackcurrants, topped off with a frosty Menthol exhale. This flavour offers a perfectly balanced mix of refreshing fruit and cooling ice, ideal for vapers who love vibrant, fruity blends with a crisp, icy finish. This 100ml bottle of nicotine-free e-liquid has space for 20ml of nicotine shots, allowing you to create the perfect nicotine strength for your needs. To make 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots, shake well, and your e-liquid is ready to vape. Shortfills are a cost-effective and convenient option for vapers who enjoy larger quantities of their favourite flavours. With their higher VG content, shortfills are ideal for use with high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, delivering maximum flavour and dense vapour production. Save time and money by stocking up on Yeti Summit shortfills. Discover the Yeti Summit range, crafted by UK-based e-liquid masters Prohibition. Yeti Summit offers a super-frosty collection of flavours that blend authentic fruit profiles with a bracing layer of crisp, icy menthol, for maximum flavour and refreshment.
